run_wanmodel_forward: run the WanModel forward pass with hidden states, encoder hidden states, and timestep tensors
build_wanmodel: build a WanModel instance from MOVAVideoConfig, hf_config dict, and optional QuantizationConfig
create_self_attention: create a SelfAttention module with dim, num_heads, eps, and optional quant_config for distributed DiT
create_cross_attention: create a CrossAttention module with dim, num_heads, eps, and optional quant_config for text-conditioned attention
summarize_ditblock: summarize the DiTBlock architecture including self-attention, cross-attention, MLP, and modulation layers
